newsitem.title: FRANCE: Debate on franc cost France "billions" - Jospin.
newsitem.headline: Debate on franc cost France "billions" - Jospin.

text.p: The leader of the French Socialist opposition Lionel Jospin charged on Sunday that the debate on the franc triggered by former French president Valery Giscard d'Estaing drained central bank reserves by "billions of francs."
"What I reproach Valery Giscard d'Estaing is that he couldn't frame his concerns without speculating on the franc," Jospin told Europe 1 radio.

"That put us in a position of weakness relative to the Germans...It lost us reserves, several billion francs in several days. It forced the prime minister to sign a statement with the Germans that further tightened the laces," he said.
He said the Socialist Party wants to frame the creation of a single currency within the context of the euro-dollar exchange rate and not of the franc-mark rate.
French President Jacques Chirac and German Chancellor Helmut Kohl reaffirmed on Saturday their commitment to a stable franc-mark rate in the run-up to a single European currency.

Their comments after talks in the southwestern French town of Perigueux followed 10 days of fierce debate over Giscard d'Estaing's call for a depreciation of the franc to revive economic growth and combat record unemployment.

The discussion sparked by Giscard d'Estaing's call, which drew significant sympathy on the back benches of the president's own Gaullist RPR party, knocked the franc to its lowest level since September and triggered a series of statements in Paris and Bonn aimed at reassuring currency markets.

Jospin said it was important to establish a single currency, "but under certain conditions -- (it should be accompanied by) a pact for growth and solidarity, and the euro should not be overvalued against the dollar."
He said major EU countries including Britain, Italy and Spain should join in the single currency from the beginning.
"We don't wish for a club of currencies revolving around the mark. We want a single currency," Jospin said.
